canonical_path_mapping: External canonical output is rebased below canonical_restored_prefix with its hierarchy and bytes unchanged. Repository files retain their original repository-relative paths.

canonical_result.later_explicit_trust_zero_audits: Retained verbatim in the frozen independent review evidence; consult its receipt and raw logs.

original_canonical_FILES.scope: Original verifier snapshot retained verbatim; later audit/review files may not be indexed by this earlier snapshot.

published_author_attempts_not_repackaged.scope: Author attempt trees remain separately published and locally unchanged. Only selected exact dependency/provenance inputs from those trees are needed in this final independent archive.

preservation: All selected original file bytes remain unchanged. Compiler objects are omitted and explicitly listed separately; the original FILES inventory has no compiler-object entries. No Lean or Git command is run by packaging.
archive_metadata_policy: Sorted regular members; mode 0644; uid/gid/mtime zero; blank owner/group names; gzip filename empty and mtime zero; gzip compression level 9.
reproducibility: Use --repack-from-root with a restored repository root and this manifest to reproduce and check identical tar.gz bytes in a new output directory.

machinery_reuse.packer_scope: Reused path/regular-file/normalized tar-gzip/repack machinery; final receipt and source selection adapted to this 17-module contribution.
machinery_reuse.helper_modifications: None: exact byte-identical copy, with the same default filenames in a new directory.
machinery_reuse.validation_scope: Same verify-only, one fresh safe extraction, and original-byte comparison recipe; task-specific restore prefix and metadata label updated.
